title: A Bounded Evaluation Protocol for Representational Systematicity
abstract: arXiv:2611.01755v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multiple studies have shown that neural networks can be behaviorally systematic, producing correct outputs for novel combinations of familiar parts. Whether they are also representationally systematic, that is, whether they represent these parts and their roles and use them to produce the outputs, remains hard to test, because each kind of evidence can mislead on its own: correct outputs can come from shortcuts, a decodable signal need not be used, an intervention can act through unintended pathways, and a failed search does not show absence. We propose a bounded evaluation protocol for representational systematicity (Bounded-RS): for an explanation that attributes a systematic behavior to a declared representation, it tests on a matched behavioral contrast whether that representation is recoverable and whether it is causally used, checks the validity of this evidence, and assigns the explanation one of four bounded states, Unsupported,

translated_title: 表征系统性的有界评估协议
translated_abstract: 多项研究表明，神经网络在行为上可以具有系统性，即能够对熟悉部分的新颖组合产生正确的输出。然而，它们是否也在表征上具有系统性——即是否真正表征了这些部分及其角色，并利用这些表征来产生输出——仍然难以检验，因为每一种证据本身都可能造成误导：正确的输出可能来自捷径，可解码的信号未必真正被使用，干预操作可能通过非预期的路径发挥作用，而搜索失败也不能证明其不存在。我们提出了一种针对表征系统性的有界评估协议（Bounded-RS）：对于将某种系统性行为归因于一个所声明表征的解释，该协议在一个匹配的行为对比上检验该表征是否可被恢复、以及是否被因果地使用，检查这些证据的有效性，并将该解释归入四种有界状态之一，即“不支持”（Unsupported）等。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个针对表征系统性的有界评估协议，通过在匹配的行为对比上同时检验所声明表征的可恢复性与因果使用，并对解释赋予四种有界状态之一，从而解决了单一类型证据容易误导的验证难题。
en_tdlr: Proposes Bounded-RS, a bounded evaluation protocol for representational systematicity that tests both the recoverability and causal use of a declared representation on matched behavioral contrasts, checks evidence validity, and assigns explanations one of four bounded states.
